name: Allison Apperson
quote: Frendo and I worked together on the Solo Stove creative edit and then a few case studies for the same job. I hadn't met him before November, but really enjoyed working with him. He was calm in a stressful setting, he had a solution for things when they went sideways (story time: at first, we had a little difficulty getting what we needed from our animator for the first Solo case study - I was working as a team of one in person and Frendo helped make sure the process of feeding changes accurately and timely to our off-site animator was all buttoned - he made the process a lot smoother with our skeleton creative team of just me in the room). Frendo also had some nice ideas for the work. Producers know edits. He had some ideas here and there that made the social pieces in particular a lot better. The guy also understands how to work with clients. Sure, were one big team, but he treated me, Chase, Mik, the whole group with a lot of respect and always made sure we were taken care of on coffee, lunch, etc. Like, went above and beyond to keep us smiling while we were under pressure. I love that.

name: Jade Benson-Smith
quote: I feel very lucky to work alongside Frendo. Not only is he a great manager, he is also a wonderful producer. I never worry about handing projects to him, as I know when I return, he has kept everyone on track and informed. Frendo is super approachable, which helps me feel comfortable sharing any hiccups I might have on a project or even in my own career here. Any time I have a comment or concern, I immediately feel at ease knowing that Frendo takes these very seriously. He also offers objective advice from his own experience in the industry, without invalidating or disregarding my experiences. Not only does he champion me as a producer, I can confidently say he does the same for the entirety of Team Offline. He genuinely wants to see us grow individually and as an entity. He fights for structure, process, procedure, and us as people. Overall, I can't say enough good things about my experience working with Frendo.

name: Brian Gregory
quote:
Chris is a great leader. He has a great attitude and is very easy to work with. He is always trying to improve our department and is accepting of all our ideas and suggestions. He is well organized and not afraid to speak his mind or fight for us when we are put in difficult situations such as very tight deadlines, unclear direction from creative, and when we are worked too hard.

Chris has been the best supervisor I have had since I started over 6 years ago. He has shown great respect for my craft and is always in my corner and always fighting for me to move up in my career. I have never felt more advocated for.

name: Dustin Dodd
quote: I recently worked with Chris Frendo on 2x two minute GEICO Caveman spots and a :15 Gecko-Os Spot. The experience on all of it was top notch. Chris was on top of everything, communicated, collaborated and problem solved to make the work the best it could be through offline, flame/finishing and mix.

name: Mel Calabro
quote: Just wanted to send you a little note to tell you how much I enjoyed working with Frendo on the General Mills pitch! He was so on top of everything, managing all of the artists (staff and freelance) and working with us to get a bigger boat as deliverables and needs changed throughout, including over the weekend. He also kept his cool during the home stretch when the workflow got more intense! I really felt the partnership working with him and hope we get the chance to do it again soon!

name: Angela Williams
quote:
I had the privilege of working alongside Chris at SuperJoy, and he is truly an inspiring leader. As a Senior Post Producer, Chris consistently delivered excellence, managing complex projects with precision and ensuring every detail was flawless.

What sets Chris apart is his dedication to his team. He has an incredible ability to mentor and grow his people, providing thoughtful guidance that fosters both professional and personal development. His team members thrive under his leadership, taking on new challenges with confidence.

I wholeheartedly recommend Chris to any team or organization seeking a dedicated, empowering leader who consistently drives results and inspires growth.

name: Will Rummel
quote:
Chris is an excellent producer and people leader. He approaches each project with respect for the final product, and he thinks deeply about intent in order to make creative and technical recommendations to ensure the best possible outcomes. He advocates for artists constantly, and provides daily feedback that I find invaluable. He cares about everyone around him as people, and seeks to help everyone who reports to him achieve their maximum potential.

I know that I can count on Chris at all times, whether for a creative decision, a client management dilemma, or career advice.

Additionally, Chris' projects run smoothly, on schedule, and largely under budget. Most recently on GEICO Pickles, he helped me drill down to very solid edits quickly which gave us the time to do additional color work that wowed the creative team. He adjusted the calendar with my input, and we ended up ahead of schedule, which allowed us to sell through a few :30s in addition to the planned deliverables. Chris' input has improved many junior producers on the Martin side, especially Zavi (who was already great to begin with) who has developed a Deliverables tracker that blows all other teams out of the water.

Chris has also been invaluable as I find my voice with creative teams and their CDs, helping me strike the right tone as we go through revisions and new creative avenues as a project plays out.

Chris is very kind when giving criticism. The first day on the Snoop Solo Case Study back in November, I had a bad attitude that was pretty out of the ordinary for me. When we had a moment alone, he said that it was showing and that the creatives were noticing, and encouraged me to turn it around. I did, and that project went on to be very successful with both creatives giving me excellent feedback, and that might not have happened if Chris didn't help me so early on.

All in all, Chris is a level-headed, passionate, thoughtful, creative, and caring producer. 10/10.

name: Noelle Schneider
quote: If you were to ask me who I believe to be the most passionate, hard working and dedicated creative visionary…it would be Chris hands down. We have been working together at Fatbird for many years and I can wholeheartedly say that he puts his blood, sweat and tears into every project he touches and it shows! His knowledge, expertise, dedication and love for storytelling is admirable and inspiring. If you have the chance to work with Chris don't let it pass you by. You will leave learning something new and feeling inspired. I know I do, everyday.

name: Teresa Hanula
quote:
Working with Chris was a breath of fresh air! I have been a dog trainer and an animal wrangler on set for many years. This was a specific shoot that was challenging yet super incredible on which my dog was able to work with a human and equine actor! On many occasions, it has been our experience that other production companies aren't always well versed in animal behavior or barely even have realistic expectations.

But Chris and his team were exactly what any trainer could ask and DREAM for! They had researched and already knew exactly what behaviors my dog knew and was capable of well ahead of time! They had their shot list organized and ready to go (because you never want to leave an animal waiting to shoot)! They had amazing creative ideas as we went along and in those moments, they asked US, the animal talent, what might be possible first. This was the best way to set clear expectations for everyone. It was truly a team effort where everyone felt heard, important and all needs were met. It didn't matter what was happening, when I mentioned that my dog might need a break or a drink, or a practice session, his needs absolutely came first!!!

Animal welfare and a team atmosphere were the highest priorities here! It led to the job getting done quickly, accurately and in a very happy and supportive environment. The final product exceeded any expectations that I think anyone could have dreamed of.

Chris' passion for both film and animals really shines through!! His skills of working with people are unmatched. I'd have to say this is a pretty perfect trifecta! I couldn't recommend him more highly!

name: Lee Lieburn
quote:
I just wanted to write this recommendation for my friend Chris Frendo. In the short time he was here, Chris immediately made a huge impact. Chris wrote out and charted future positions and goals for this department which the DOS is slowly beginning to implement. On a personal level, I almost don't have the words. Chris elevated my game 100%. He went through upgraded our equipment list and was hands on with me as I went through the learning curve. His patience, his encouragement but most of all his PASSION. His passion for the pursuit of perfection is something I admire and respect! Chris taught new ways to think about everything and anything video and editing related. As I said, his impact on me was profound! With all this being said, Chris and I are friends and I consider Chris a dear friend! I promise, once you meet with Chris and discuss your production needs you will see what I mean. Recommended 1000%

Thanks Chris for all you did for me!

name: Nicholas Costa
quote:
Chris is one of those team members that pushes you to grow in your role. He is the kind of team leader that I have seen grow over time and help his teammates find their opportunities for success. As a leader, I would recommend anyone to join Chris' team. As someone who had the opportunity to work with Chris, I find myself lucky. He really worked with me to develop my strengths and confidence as a producer.

As a producer, Chris is one of the most thorough and dedicated guys in the space. He is passionate about the creative work he does and wants to do whatever he can to make it come to life. He has a talented creative eye that is an amazing asset for his production skills.

I am honored to have worked with Chris. I have learned so much from him as a producer and leader.

name: Tom Heckbert
quote: This dude rocks. Anytime you needed something done quickly, professionally and creatively he could handle it... whatever you threw at him. It was a pleasure to edit his projects mainly because it went smoothly. He thinks things through completely and has his bases covered streamlining the process and I am sure saving money for the clients in the long run. His projects always exceeded clients expectations and found creative solutions to many issues he was forced to work around. Now with his new venture, Fatbird Creative, he has assembled a fantastic, talent packed team. I would sincerely reach out to them should you need their services and check out their website. You won't regret it.

name: Anne Johnson
quote:
I have known Chris for years and recently I had the opportunity to work with both him and Noelle at Fatbird Creative. The organization and communication practices of their team went well beyond my expectations. The Fatbird team listened to what my company's needs and wants were, understood my parameters, provided guidance and delivered an absolutely amazing finished product well within the timeline that was presented.

Even though my company's needs were not large-scale, Chris and Noelle made me feel as if my project was just as important to them as it was to me. I genuinely enjoyed working with both Chris and Noelle and I regularly recommend Fatbird Creative to anyone I hear of looking for help with their marketing or advertising needs.

name: Tyler Conta McLeod
quote:
I truthfully couldn't have asked for a better coworker, collaborator, and creative teammate than Chris. In pre, production, and post I saw Chris navigate through numerous difficult projects/tasks and come out with fantastic results.

He had numerous successful relationships with clients thanks to remarkably creative ideas, his drive to succeed, and his sense of humor. His work helped elevate our company to a new level (essentially acting as Creative Director), all while raising up our clients to new heights courtesy of some of the best work our company had done in years. Chris would be a wonderful addition to any company, a great guide for any brand, or a terrific mentor to any creative thinkers.

name: Marco Maceri
quote:
It had been a few years since last I worked with Chris, so when the opportunity presented itself in the form of a video project integral to our company's new product launch — a disruptive XR SaaS platform — I leapt at the chance to engage him. Chris brings a wealth of experience and accrued knowledge to all his projects, that's true, but he brings something more: intuition derived from innate artistic ability.

It may sound a bit clichéd, but Chris is a natural, and has a way of tapping into a given video project's "pulse", so to speak; getting to the heart of it faster and more completely than anyone I've ever had the pleasure of working with.

Chris Frendo is the real deal and I can't wait to work with him again.

name: Corrie Poland
quote: Chris was critical in the production of our video for the Air Force. He led the process along seamlessly and with creativity, attention to detail, and passion. Hope to work together again!

name: Rich Diller
quote: Chris is a creative producer that delivered above and beyond what was asked of him as a producer. He is beyond qualified to produce video projects and can help out any company tremendously with video production and beyond.

name: Darcy Boerio
quote: Chris is energetic, passionate, sharp, accountable, and a pleasure to work with. His work speaks for itself. I've been extremely pleased with the professionalism and quality of his end products. When we worked together, I was always proud to share his videos whenever possible, and they definitely contributed to increased revenue for the company!

name: Jack Evans
quote: Chris has an incredibly unique skillset, blending an aptitude for marketing strategy with advanced abilities in videography and production. Behind the camera, Chris does a great job of controlling the setting and making his subjects comfortable- naturally capturing the footage he needs. In both planning and post-production settings, Chris is able to see the big picture and has a keen ability to build brands through visual storytelling. He is highly passionate about the brands he works for/with, and I would comfortably recommend him to anybody looking for a Video Producer.

name: Ashley Fenlon
quote: Chris Frendo is one of the most dynamic and creative free-thinkers I have ever had the pleasure to work with. His passion and dedication for video production are apparent in everything he does, resulting in masterful visual storytelling. Would recommend 10/10.

name: Ted Goudie
quote:
I recommend Chris Frendo without reservation, because he's been a valued member of our marketing team since joining more than a year ago. I hired him because of his experience in marketing & advertising, working for some of the most respected agencies (and biggest clients!) in the country.

Chris' well-rounded marketing mind earns my highest recommendation, even though we hired him for a video production role. He brings valuable ideas and input to all of our marketing activities and content production/promotion campaign.

His role with us is to generate thought-provoking content to increase brand awareness and traffic to our websites, which drive more leads to our sales team, recruits to our HR team, and positive experiences for our customers. The content he has produced is top-notch and have helped move the business forward.

Chris is capable of seeing a video project all the way from vision through requirements, scripting, storyboarding, production, editing, and publishing.

Beyond the work stuff, Chris is also a great fun guy to have on the team, and he's respected across our organization for his willingness to jump in and help without hesitation.

name: Dr. J.J. Martin, Ph.D., MS, MA, BS
role: Director, Training Support Analysis & Integration Directorate
quote: Chris is the epitome of a team player and enthusiastically stepped up into a leadership role when FASTC needed mission accomplishment. His undying dedication to getting the production and editing precise the first time was instrumental in the transformation of the Media Center. He is one of the utmost professional and talented Producers I have ever met. His work as the Senior Producer for FASTC is above reproach and always set the example for the rest of the Team. Chris sets himself apart from his peers through his extensive experience and keen eye for perfection. Chris approached every task with the goal of providing the best product to students, without compromising quality. He is able to balance multiple complex tasks with exceptional time management skills. Any company looking for a dedicated team player with personal integrity of doing the right thing – will do well with gaining Chris, as he will rapidly establish standards above expectations.

name: Eli Ruhf
quote:
Chris is a charismatic, creative storyteller with fantastic vision, innate composition abilities and an unfaltering, collaborative drive.

Simply put, he's an amazing talent to work with.

name: Shawn Hamer
quote: Chris is so easy to work with! He 'gets it' quickly and knows a good idea when he sees. Highly recommended for anyone looking to get it done - and to get it done right!

name: Nate Zemanek
quote: Chris has a clear vision. And that in itself means a lot in a production environment. But he also has the skills, knowledge and fortitude to see his projects through to the end personally. His videos are visually compelling, thoughtfully paced and meticulously produced. Chris doesn't stop until the deliverable is as good as it can possibly be, and if that means working long days, nights and weekends, then so be it. He always says: "The product comes first." Working with him has been a joy. He has a passion for his craft, and it absolutely shows both in his results and in his demeanor. He is humble and considerate as a team member, but also resolute and determined to get it done right. I learned a lot from Chris, and I'll be anxious to watch where he goes from here.
